how.studiesLine: Almost every study here counted cigarette smokers, most of them before vapes were common, and none counted nicotine-pouch users. Each card says who was counted.
how.intro: What studies found about quitting, and who they counted.
how.feelLine: What you'll feel, day by day, and what helps:

privacy.askThroughCoaching: Ask through the coaching page and we delete it within 30 days.

coaching.costLabel: What it costs you a year
coaching.stripeLine: Payment goes through Stripe. This site stores nothing about it.

blackbox.undone: Taken back out of your Black Box.
blackbox.notSaved: Could not save this one in your Black Box.

sos.line: Pick any tool. Nothing here asks you anything first.
sos.otherNote: Name it anyway, then pick any tool on the shelf.
sos.breatheLine: Hold the button while you breathe out. Let go and breathe in. The circle follows you.
sos.bubblesLine: Pop them. There is nothing to win.
sos.blocksLine: Swipe or use the arrow keys. Equal numbers merge.
sos.moveLine: Walk, take the stairs, or do push-ups against a wall.
sos.moveDesign: A review that pooled studies, using each participant's own data.
sos.moveMeasured: How strong cigarette cravings were soon after physical activity.
sos.moveCaveat: It measured cravings soon after the activity, not whether people stayed off. It studied cigarette cravings.
sos.moveWho: Smokers who had not smoked for a while, in the studies the review pooled.
sos.moveFinding: In these studies, cigarette cravings were lower soon after a short spell of physical activity.
sos.helpLine: Pick the place you are in to see what to do there.
sos.reasonsLine: Your own words, kept on this phone.
sos.noRowLine: Optional: how strong was it, and where were you?
sos.newerSaved: Something you changed here had already been saved in a newer version, so the newer one was kept.
sos.rowUpdated: Updated the one from a few minutes ago.
sos.yesTitle: A slip doesn't undo the days before.
sos.yesStep: Today, go back through steps 1–3 on paper: your top lies, your swaps, a new day 1.
sos.patternWait: After three saves, your most common moments show here.
sos.fightNote: Still fighting is a fine answer. Stay with the wait below.

symptoms.intro: Tap one to see what the studies say.
sleepRules: Get up at the same time every day, whatever the night was like.
Use the bed for sleep only.
If you are still awake after 20 minutes, get up and come back when sleepy.
It is worst in the first 1 to 2 weeks.
